correctness.rationale: The general reciprocal loss-gain GLV equations yield the exact feasible equilibria with constants S,T,Q. A strict positive diagonal Lyapunov multiplier gives \(PJ_3+J_3^{\mathsf T}P=-2\operatorname{diag}(c/a,d/b,1)\); the missing-consumer eigenvalue is \(WQ\). The full coexistence symmetric/antisymmetric characteristic determinants are \(XYS\) and \(XYQ\), proving all hyperbolic stability classifications. At \(Q=0\) the singular equilibrium coefficient matrix has nullity one, and its feasible affine solution has endpoint E1 and E2. The canonical fixed family has nine equilibria off criticality: direct exhaustive support arguments exclude others and positive invasion eigenvalues exclude all remaining stable equilibria. The standard-library rational verification script independently checks 72 feasible parameter tuples, two complete support censuses and the critical segment; universal claims rest on the proof, not on enumeration.

originality.rationale: The full Dopson–Emary bipartite ensemble paper, Giraldo–Lee mutualism analysis, Livesay and Hong–Pego general Lotka–Volterra stability-exclusion results, and relevant indexed claims were compared at implication level. The ensemble results concern large random positive-correlation trophic matrices, rather than an exact finite opposite-preference rank determinant. Mutualistic reciprocal interactions and generic nested-community exclusions do not yield the nine-equilibrium support census or nonisolated 2+2 antagonistic transition. No covering statement was identified, but specialist unindexed precedents remain a substantive residual risk.
residual_risks: Some specialist finite 2+2 trophic-network studies or classical generalized Lotka–Volterra bifurcation treatments may contain the same rank condition under different notation.
Public indexed closest neutral-segment finding could be compared only from its full summary because the linked repository page was inaccessible.
The model deliberately assumes mismatched damage versus benefit rankings, whose prevalence in measured antagonistic systems is not established.

value.rationale: A natural smallest heterogeneous bipartite consumer-resource community has a biologically interpretable competition between opposite rankings of resource damage and consumer benefit. The exact mismatch product threshold separates single coexistence from alternative consumer-extinction sinks, and a positive critical continuum mediates the change. Full support and local-attractor census at an explicit positive one-parameter family makes a finite but complete and useful structural phase diagram, beyond a normalization check, arbitrary parameter slice, or code-only observation.
